# Junction Industries, LLC
> Veteran-owned industrial, infrastructure, and heavy civil holding company headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas.

Junction Industries provides foundational support for market-leading industrial businesses across North America, focusing on heavy engineering, structural steel fabrication, foundation drilling, bulk material handling, and automated parking systems.

## Wholly-Owned Operating Entities
- Trident Structures: Industrial design-build EPC company specializing in bulk material handling, concrete batch plants, rail transload terminals, and automated high-density parking systems. URL: https://www.trident-structures.com/
- Harbor Fab: Over 70,000 square feet across three regional Texas shops for AISC and AWS D1.1 certified structural steel fabrication, stairs, handrails, catwalks, embeds, and roof frames.
- Advanced Intralogistics: Automated Vehicle Storage and Retrieval Systems (AVSRS) and industrial conveyor material handling systems delivering maximum real estate density and sub-90s retrieval.
- Pier 57: Niche commercial and industrial real estate development company specializing in automated parking integration, logistics facilities, and waterfront marine infrastructure.
- Grey Oaks Property Management: Commercial and industrial property management solutions, equipment laydown yards, and facility operations.
- Palo 32 Luxury Safari Getaway: Exclusive Texas luxury hospitality and corporate retreat destination.
